about.label: About Metwork
about.title: The network where Algeria's startups connect, grow, and scale.
about.body1: Metwork is Algeria's unified startup platform — built to bring together founders, investors, and incubators under one roof. Whether you're launching your first product or managing a portfolio of programs, we built this for you.
about.body2: We believe Algeria's next great companies won't be built in isolation. They'll emerge through the right connections — the right mentors, the right capital, and the right community, all in the same room.
about.pillar1Desc: Hands-on programs, coworking space, and expert mentorship for early-stage Algerian startups.
about.pillar2Desc: A curated network bridging founders with investors, mentors, and incubators across the country.
about.pillar3Desc: Tools and partnerships to help Algerian startups grow beyond local markets and reach new frontiers.

landing.socialProof: Trusted by founders, investors, and incubators across Algeria.
